title: Kasson Lab DNA Extraction
author: Angie Macias
materials: Sterilize some metal scrapers with flame and 95 % (v/v) Ethyl Alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #E7023 .
Flame-sterilize and cool scrapers between samples.

Using a P1000 micropipette, transfer supernatant to each tube containing isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907 and gently mix by inversion. It's better to leave some liquid than to carry bits of the protein pellet into the next step.

Using a P1000 micropipette, transfer supernatant to each tube containing isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907 and gently mix by inversion. It's better to leave some liquid than to carry bits of the protein pellet into the next step.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the water bath and reagents for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Turn on hot water bath and set to 65 °C.
Place a sufficient aliquot of Elution buffer pH 8.0 (250 mL) Alfa Aesar Catalog #J61558 into the 65 °C water bath to warm.

steps.title: Label and Prepare Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare two 1.5 mL Eppendorf centrifuge tubes per sample.

substeps.instruction: Label both sets of tubes with short sample names.
Label one tube set per sample with an 'I' for isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907.
Add 600 µL of Cell Lysis Solution, 1000ml (for Wizard Genomic) Promega Catalog #A7933 (or Nuclei Lysis Solution, 1000ml Promega Catalog #A7943) to the tubes without the 'I' label.
Add 600 µL of isopropyl alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #W292907 to the tubes labeled with 'I'.

steps.title: Sample Maceration and Lysis
steps.instruction: Process the fungal tissue to release DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/2 pea-sized amount of fungal tissue (young hyphae) to each tube containing Cell Lysis Solution.
Macerate each sample with a new, sterile micropestle until the tissue is homogenous.
Place tubes in a floating rack and incubate in the 65 °C water bath for 00:30:00.
Remove samples, vortex for 00:00:03, and return to the 65 °C water bath for another 00:30:00.
Remove samples and allow them to cool on the bench for 00:05:00.
Add 200 µL of Protein Precipitation Solution 350ml Promega Catalog #A7953 to each tube and vortex for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge samples for 00:03:00 at 14,000 rpm.
Unload samples carefully into a rack.

steps.title: DNA Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Isolate and wash the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 14,000 rpm.
Carefully pour off the supernatant into a waste container, ensuring the white DNA pellet is not lost.
Add 600 µL of 70% (v/v) Ethyl Alcohol Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #E7023 to each tube and mix gently by inversion.
Centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 14,000 rpm.
Repeat the addition of 600 µL of 70% (v/v) Ethyl Alcohol and the 00:01:00 centrifuge step at 14,000 rpm.

steps.title: DNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Open and invert tubes onto a clean paper towel (a tube rack can be placed on the lids to secure them).
Add 100 µL of warmed Elution buffer pH 8.0 (250 mL) Alfa Aesar Catalog #J61558 to each tube.
Store fully-labeled tubes in a box (not a tube rack) in the -20 °C freezer.
